This [k=glossary/story_weapon]Weapon[/k] starts the fight active on the Defender.

When performing a Dash or charging a Heavy Attack, gain a non-stacking [k=glossary/unstoppable]Unstoppable[/k] Passive for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 7 seconds.

applications.name: Dawn of Protection
applications.description: The Defender gains Indefinite Protection Passives every 14 seconds reducing Damage by 30%. Remove one Protection Passive from the Defender when they are struck for the first time by a Medium Combo Ender, the final hit of a Heavy Attack, or final hit of a Special Attack. After a Protection Passive has been removed by one of these Attacks they cannot be removed again until reset. Attack actions are reset after completing each one once. Max stacks: 5.

Remove one Protection Passive from the Defender when they are struck for the first time by a Medium Combo Ender, the final hit of a Heavy Attack, or final hit of a Special Attack. After a Protection Passive has been removed by one of these Attacks they cannot be removed again until reset. Attack actions are reset after completing each one once. Max stacks: {3}.

applications.description: Every 20 second(s), the Attacker is afflicted with a Degeneration Passive, dealing 100% of the Defender's Attack Rating over 6 second(s).
